testSteps.description: 1: User views credential (PID/attestation) issuance/re-issuance transaction details ({Detail=DateTime, Description=The date and time of the transaction})

children.description: Given the user is registered to a valid EUDI Wallet on their mobile device
And the user is authenticated in the EUDI Wallet
Given the user is on the History screen
When the user selects a credential issuance or reissuance transaction entry from the list
Then the EUDI Wallet presents the following details by DateTime and The date and time of the transaction

userStory.narrative:
As a EUDI Wallet User
  I want to view any transaction in my EUDI Wallet
  So that I can review the details of my transaction
